jobs.title: Chief Executive Officer
jobs.description:
CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER
Residential HVAC Services — Fort Lauderdale, FL
Flying Horse Capital | Ownership Track

THE OPPORTUNITY

Flying Horse Capital has acquired a residential HVAC services company in the Fort Lauderdale market—a founder-owned and operated business with more than 20 years of history and approximately $6M in annual revenue. We are looking for the next CEO to lead the business through its next chapter. If you came up through the trade, have been running somebody else's shop, and have wondered when you would get the opportunity to build something of your own, this is that seat. Real equity. Real authority. And an owner behind you who is not operating on a five-year clock.

ABOUT FLYING HORSE CAPITAL

We are a Dallas-based permanent capital firm that acquires lower-middle-market family- and founder-owned businesses. We are not a private equity fund. No fund life. No five-year clock. No forced exit. We buy good businesses and hold them.

THE ROLE

You run the company—the P&L, the team, the customers, and the outcome.
This is a $6M business, not a corporate platform. There is no large corporate infrastructure behind you. You will be close to the technicians, the customers, and the numbers every day.

You will own:

Field operations
— dispatch, scheduling, service delivery, installation crews, fleet, inventory, permitting, and safety
The crew
— technician recruiting, retention, development, and accountability. At this size, losing two good technicians is a material event, particularly in a highly competitive labor market
Customers
— service standards, callback rates, online reputation, customer retention, and maintenance-agreement growth
Unit economics
— gross margin by service line, labor utilization, average ticket, close rates, and overall profitability
Growth
— strengthening the core business and expanding market share across Broward and adjacent counties
Culture
— maintaining what made the business successful while building the accountability, processes, and team required for its next stage of growth

YOU WILL NOT BE DOING THIS ALONE

A structured 90-day handoff from the founder—accounts, vendors, referral sources, customer relationships, and the institutional knowledge that lives in no system
A fractional CFO provided by Flying Horse Capital to own reporting, cash management, budgeting, and lender relationships. You own the P&L; you will not be in QuickBooks at midnight

A Sales Director we will fund and recruit once the business is stabilized, reporting directly to you
Support navigating the licensing and qualifying-agent transition, including applicable examination or licensing requirements
Direct access to ownership. One phone call. Fast decisions.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

You started in the field as a hands-on HVAC technician. You have run diagnostics, pulled a compressor, and had the hard conversation with a homeowner in August
You have since led—as a service manager, operations manager, GM, or branch manager—in a multi-truck residential HVAC environment
You have carried accountability for roughly $3M+ in revenue and 10+ field personnel. You do not need to have run a large platform. You need to have run something real, and run it well

You understand the economics of a residential service business and know how technician productivity, pricing, close rates, callbacks, and customer retention ultimately flow through the P&L
You want ownership, not a bigger title

You are relentlessly hands-on. At this size, that is not a preference—it is the job

Strongly preferred:
An active Florida CAC license or candidates positioned to meet applicable Florida licensing requirements. Also valued: maintenance-program growth experience, South Florida or Gulf Coast market experience, and bilingual English/Spanish capabilities. If you hold an applicable Florida license, lead with it.

COMPENSATION

Meaningful equity participation a genuine owner alongside Flying Horse Capital, not a token grantee
Long-term opportunity to build personal wealth through the growth of the business

LOCATION

Fully onsite in greater Fort Lauderdale / Broward County. Candidates requiring relocation are encouraged to apply.

OUR VIEW

We believe the right CEO is the single most important factor in a successful ownership transition. The capital and the structure are replaceable. The operator is not.
We are selective about who we partner with. We are looking for an operator who wants to take real ownership of a business, build something lasting, and participate directly in the value they create.

Executive

Full-time

Job function

jobs.title: Program Director, Nuclear Medicine Technician
jobs.description:
The Program Director provides leadership in managing, planning, and implementing the program in

support of College and/or departmental goals in order to assure compliance with programmatic

accreditation and/or licensure, internal consistency, and graduate outcomes to meet placement

expectations. Participates in curriculum development and coordination, determines teaching assignments

using a blended instructional approach combining face-to-face instruction with on-line instruction (as

applicable), selection of faculty, and coordination of program specific external facilities and instruction.

Provides professional leadership and support for teaching faculty; serves as a mentor and facilitator for

faculty assigned; and enables an environment which fosters creativity, responsiveness, and self-responsibility.

Essential Functions And Responsibilities

Teaching Functions
May teach based upon the needs of the business and/or student enrollment in the program.
Delivers curriculum by approved syllabi, according to program objectives and lesson plans.
May utilize blended instructional approach, a combination of face-to-face instruction and on-line instruction.
Ensures all the components of the course(s) is set up, including but not limited to the syllabus, reading and work assignments, and evaluation mechanisms such as quizzes and exams.

Administrative Functions
Plans, directs and provides daily guidance of didactic, laboratory, and scheduling of classes.
Reviews, monitors and makes curriculum and textbook proposals as indicated by program evaluation, accreditation/licensure requirements, and/or market needs.
Develops curricula, and plans course content and methods of instruction in collaboration with the appropriate Academic Department.
Directs program activities to ensure compliance with applicable federal, state and local laws and regulations, accrediting bodies, and college policies and procedures in concert with other American Career College programs.
Manages daily operations, staffing and expenses to remain within budget guidelines.
Contributes to ongoing program assessment/revision through surveys, teleconferences, Program Advisory Committee meetings.
Coordinates and actively participates in Program Advisory Committee (PAC).
Advises on equipment, supplies, textbooks, labs and library holdings. Selects books, materials, supplies, and equipment for training, courses, or projects used in program instruction.
Ensures all communication regarding the applicable program board, accrediting and/or licensing agency, changes to program content, physical facilities, and faculty, legal receipts/requests for documents, and/or completion of required reports to maintain programmatic accreditation and/or licensure status is coordinated through the appropriate Administrative Department.

Faculty Oversight
Provides direction, motivation, support, technical/professional guidance, and training to department personnel.
Recruits, supervises and evaluates faculty; improves retention, morale and monitors performance.
Holds periodic faculty meetings to provide for subject matter correlation and curriculum evaluation, and to coordinate activities of faculty.
Ensures faculty are recording daily class attendance and grades as required, completes and submits homework assignments timely, and grades tests, quizzes, lab assignments promptly.

Student Outcomes
Monitors and analyzes student attrition and retention data and works with other college leaders to develop initiatives that can be implemented to improve retention.
Assures students are provided support services to maintain the highest level of student achievement while safeguarding the integrity of the educational process.
Ensures student satisfaction surveys are administered at least bi-annually, and that the feedback is provided to faculty in a timely fashion.
Ensures processes are in place to track, monitor and record student outcomes including graduation rates, credentialing rates, and placement rates and provides required reports as needed.
Participates in graduation ceremonies.

Professional Development
Maintains required credentials and knowledge in teaching field.
Participates in professional development and organizations to maintain an understanding of current ideas, research and practices, attends meetings, workshops and seminars to enrich personal growth, knowledge and skill in management development.
Performs other duties as assigned.

Required Education, Certifications, And Licensures

Master’s degree from an accredited academic institution.
Certification and registration in Nuclear Medicine Technology from a national certification board.
CPR Certification.

Required Experience And Skills

Minimum of four (4) years post certification nuclear medicine technology experience; and
At least one (1) year of experience teaching in the didactic and/or clinical setting of a nuclear
medicine technology program.

#HEJ

Do you want a career that allows you to make a difference in other people’s lives? Discover what it means to truly believe in the work that you do at American Career College.

For more than 40 years American Career College has had the privilege of educating students seeking careers in healthcare—guiding them through their transformational journey from student to caregiver. Our associates are united behind that purpose and share a deep commitment to our values of teamwork, collegiality, transparency, and a student-centric approach to all we do. This focus creates an aligned, nimble, and consensus-driven culture that is solution-oriented and supports our associates’ professional growth.

American Career College is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We embrace diversity and are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment for all associates.

Director
